_doc: Single config for this suite. Relative paths are relative to this folder. Every script reads its paths from here.
_report_models_doc: T2_1/T5/T6 (added 2026-09-28) are zero-shot new-setting checkpoints, same tier as T0/T2/T3, but not added to report_models -- they are scored (table.csv/scores_item.csv via score.py auto-detection) without changing the published artifact page/gallery, which wasn't asked to be updated. T2_1 = training setting 'T2.1' (dot avoided in the key: config.py's dotted-path CLI lookup and shell associative-array keys both break on '.').

ft_models._doc: base/T0/T2/T3 each further fine-tuned on the SAME edit-instruction data (identical recipe, only the starting checkpoint differs): 1,280 rows = 640 MagicBrush *train* turns (osunlp/MagicBrush, disjoint from this suite's MagicBrush test slice, near-dup-checked against every suite input/reference image by dhash) + 640 PICA-100K pairs (Andrew613/PICA-100K, superficial prompt). 2 epochs / 160 steps, v2 T-series recipe (full-unified, LLM-LoRA r32, lr 1e-5, gen_decoder_lr 5e-5, gen_loss_weight 0.5 warmup 20, imgen_ratio 1.0, area-512 targets, global batch 16, lm_loss_weight 0, gen_resize_mode area). Data/training recipe: ../v2_suite_1/diagnosis/edit_sft/build_edit_sft.py + run_edit_sft_probe.sh. report_models unchanged; these are judged and appear in table.csv/scores_item.csv via score.py's auto-detection (any judged system not already in models/references).

probe_models._doc: Lighter sibling of ft_models, paired with THIS 200-item subset manifest rather than v2_suite_1's full 1,210-item one: base/T0/T2/T3 each further fine-tuned on ~800 rows (400 MagicBrush *train* turns + 400 PICA-100K pairs, same 1:1 ratio, seed 20260929, dhash-checked against ../manifest.jsonl's 200 items) for 1 epoch / ~50 steps, otherwise the identical v2 T-series recipe as ft_models (full-unified, LLM-LoRA r32, lr 1e-5, gen_decoder_lr 5e-5, gen_loss_weight 0.5 warmup 20, imgen_ratio 1.0, area-512 targets, global batch 16, lm_loss_weight 0, gen_resize_mode area). Data/training/eval: edit_sft_probe/{build_probe_data.py, run_probe_sft.sh, train_{base,T0,T2,T3,T2_1,T5,T6}.sh, run_probe_eval.sh}. Trained: base_probe (2026-09-28) and T2_1_probe / T5_probe / T6_probe (2026-09-29); T0/T2/T3_probe were never run (their entries below are placeholders). report_models unchanged; once judged, these are picked up by score.py's auto-detection like ft_models.

provenance._doc: Only used by scripts/sample_subset.py and scripts/import_v2_suite_1.py (one-off, already run). Nothing else reads these paths.
